name: @cinereel/sidecar
description: Hyper SDK (Corestore/Hyperdrive/Hyperswarm) REST sidecar for CineReel.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @cinereel/hyper-sdk build && SIDECAR_ENV_FILE=.env.dev NODE_ENV=development node --env-file-if-exists=.env.development --env-file-if-exists=.env.dev --enable-source-maps --watch --import tsx/esm src/index.ts
scripts.dev:peer: pnpm --filter @cinereel/hyper-sdk build && SIDECAR_ENV_FILE=.env.peer NODE_ENV=development node --env-file-if-exists=.env.development --env-file-if-exists=.env.peer --enable-source-maps --watch --import tsx/esm src/index.ts
scripts.dev:bootstrap: pnpm --filter @cinereel/hyper-sdk build && SIDECAR_ENV_FILE=.env.bootstrap NODE_ENV=development node --env-file-if-exists=.env.bootstrap --enable-source-maps --import tsx/esm src/index.ts
